relationships.evidence:
Re: Potential synergies with YouTube
Wednesday, September 21, 2022 at 1:42:58 PM Eastern Daylight
[contact omitted] Joshua Machleder
Time
To: [contact omitted] Tinaflor Chaingam
Cc: [contact omitted] Christopher Adams, [contact omitted] Elizabeth Callender, [contact omitted] Leslie
Maccracken, [contact omitted] Nils Mueller, [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
Hey Folks --
Just picking back up on this discussion. As I mentioned to some of you last night, YouTube (Josh Blumenfeld, Emily
Keller, Meredith Cherwony) is interested in moving ahead on this! Which is great.
I will send later today YouTube's edited response to Internews' concept -- they've narrowed the scope to the areas where
they feel that YouTube's contribution fits best with their strategy, defined the areas where YouTube will contribute in-kind
(through staff time/training, etc.) and, accordingly, the budget (brought down to approximately $170K). I think that despite
Internews' ambitious concept ($1million) this is a pretty good outcome as it is both realistic in terms of what kinds of
contributions we get from the private sector (actually, quite good, when you consider we're leveraging a $500k activity),
and it's a pilot for the kind of cooperation that, if it goes well, we can build upon in the future with YouTube.
Some matters that we talked through today, in brief, included: executing this in a way so that YouTube funding would go
directly to Internews (rather than through USG), issues that Nils and Elizabeth raised in terms of the timeline -- which can
be flexibly adjusted to the USAID funding (as INSPIRES work needs to close by September 2023).
Some next steps :
1) share with RDMA and Internews YouTube's scoped down version of the concept:
2) schedule and take a call with YouTube, RDMA, and Internews next week to discuss the scoped down version of the
concept; and if that goes well,
3) leave YouTube and Internews to negotiate the budget-breakdown and execute a contract. They're quite ready to move
on something quickly (although contracting is never such a rapid process).
I'll be talking to some of you later today (Wednesday evening DC time, Thursday morning Bangkok time), so if there are
any questions/issues, we can sort through those. I'm trying to be mindful of effectively, but also quickly communicating
about this through the "four corners" (USAID/DC, USAID/RDMA, Internews Asia, Internews DC).
l've copied +Vera Zakem here. Vera, please let me know if I left out some key piece of information from the discussions
earlier today with YouTube or didn't adequately convey any details.
Thanks!!!
Best,
Josh
